dashboard.label: TA-hwraid Overview
dashboard.description: Collects hardware RAID controller state from storcli3/storcli (LSI/MegaRAID), ssacli (HP) or MegaCli, if a controller is present: controller state, drive counts, failed/rebuilding

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-hwraid" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-hwraid. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-hwraid requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-hwraid", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-hwraid/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("hwraid.controller_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

index=main sourcetype="hwraid:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"drive_count\":\s*(?<n>[0-9]+)" | where isnotnull(n) AND n!="" | mvexpand n | stats sum(n) as value

index=main sourcetype="hwraid:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"failed_drives\":\s*(?<n>[0-9]+)" | where isnotnull(n) AND n!="" | mvexpand n | stats sum(n) as value

index=main sourcetype="hwraid:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"rebuilding\":\s*(?<n>[0-9]+)" | where isnotnull(n) AND n!="" | mvexpand n | stats sum(n) as value

index=main sourcetype="hwraid:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"state\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | where isnotnull(z) AND z!="" | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=product | spath input=o path=state | spath input=o path=state_ok | spath input=o path=drive_count | spath input=o path=failed_drives | spath input=o path=rebuilding | table host k product state state_ok drive_count failed_drives rebuilding
